name: pnx-fast-dev
description: PlatformNEX fast development: keeps the pnx CLI installed and up to date (a SessionStart check at most once a day, installing in the background), and teaches Claude to run an app against a real non-production environment with pnx dev intercept, connect and env, preview pull requests and reach its databases (pnx dev preview, pnx dev db), and set up and run all of a System's components (pnx dev setup, pnx dev run).
